summary_en: This study tests pirtobrutinib (also called LOXO-305) given with venetoclax in adults with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma. Both study drugs are taken by mouth, and the record does not state how long treatment lasts. Study visits are weekly during Cycle 1, then on Day 1 of every cycle for the first year, then on Day 1 of every 2 cycles. The study is Phase 2, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pirtobrutinib (también llamado LOXO-305) combinado con venetoclax en adultos con linfoma de células del manto recidivante o refractario. Ambos medicamentos del estudio se toman por vía oral, y el registro no indica cuánto tiempo dura el tratamiento. Las visitas del estudio son semanales durante el Ciclo 1, luego el Día 1 de cada ciclo durante el primer año, y después el Día 1 de cada 2 ciclos. El estudio es de Fase 2, y la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with mantle cell lymphoma that has relapsed or not responded to therapy.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Prior BTK inhibitor or anti-CD19 CAR-T therapy allowed if no prior venetoclax.
not_for: Known lymphoma involving the central nervous system, with exceptions described in the record.
Stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months of Cycle 1 Day 1.
Known uncontrolled HIV infection, with conditions for participants with HIV listed in the record.
